system:
You write the executive summary of a technical evaluation for a recruiter
(medium technical knowledge). 3-5 sentences, clear English, no gratuitous jargon.
Say: overall quality, the most important finding (if any) in terms she will understand,
and what to verify in the interview. If role_requirements are present, say in one
sentence how well the candidate appears to meet what the role asks. Factual tone —
neither salesy nor alarmist.
Respond with JSON ONLY: {"summary": "..."}
user: {"notebook": "nb01_ana_ferreira.ipynb", "decision": "AVANCAR", "scores": {"C1": 5, "C2": 5, "C3": 5, "C4": 5}, "justifications": {"C1": "Cell 7 performs a stratified train/test split before any fitting, and all preprocessing (scaling + one-hot) is inside a Pipeline/ColumnTransformer fit only on X_tr, avoiding leakage. The notebook also explicitly handles messy data (comma decimals, mixed date formats, inconsistent categories, and missing values) in cell 3 and uses an appropriate imbalance-robust metric (AUC) reported in cell 8, matching the “rigorous methodology” requirement.", "C2": "The notebook executes end-to-end without exceptions (all code cells show outputs and no errors), with fixed random_state in both the split and the model (cell 7), supporting stable results. Code is concise and readable with sklearn Pipeline used correctly (cells 7–9).", "C3": "The written conclusion claims AUC 0.729 on the test set, which matches the executed output AUC_TEST=0.729 (cell 8 and provided metricas_reais). No other numeric claims in the narrative contradict the produced results.", "C4": "Conclusions are directly supported by the evidence: key drivers cited align with the largest-magnitude coefficients printed (cell 9), and the recommendation targets a segment consistent with higher churn (monthly contracts in EDA, cell 5). It also acknowledges a concrete limitation (low recall at 0.5 threshold from cell 8) and proposes a sound next step (threshold calibration and temporal validation)."}, "findings": [], "role_requirements": "rigorous methodology"}

response.summary: Overall, the notebook is high quality and shows a solid, end-to-end ML workflow that runs cleanly and produces consistent, reproducible results. The most important finding is that the candidate prevents data leakage correctly by doing the train/test split before any fitting and keeping all preprocessing inside an sklearn Pipeline/ColumnTransformer fitted only on the training data. The reported test AUC (0.729) matches the executed output, and the conclusions are tied back to model evidence (coefficients) while noting an operational limitation (low recall at a 0.5 threshold). In the interview, verify they can explain why leakage matters, how they would choose and calibrate a decision threshold to improve recall without inflating false positives, and how they’d validate the model over time (e.g., temporal validation/drift monitoring). The candidate appears to meet the role’s “rigorous methodology” requirement very well.
